tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the Awesome Indie directory of launched indie/micro-startup products by keywords. Returns matches ranked by relevance and upvote score.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Fetch one product listing by its slug: tagline, description, maker, categories, upvotes and launch date.

tools.name: get_todays_launches
tools.description: The products launching on Awesome Indie today (UTC), in ranking order.

tools.name: get_top_products
tools.description: The ranked products for a period. Without a slug, the current period is a rolling window (last 1/7/30/365 days), exactly like the site. With a slug, an archived calendar period: daily "2026-08-06", weekly "2026-08-03" (a Monday), monthly "2026-08", yearly "2026".

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Every product category in the directory, most-populated first. Product counts are a periodic snapshot, not live.

tools.name: get_maker
tools.description: A maker profile by username: bio, links, streak, followers and their launched products.

tools.name: get_launch_availability
tools.description: When a product submitted today would launch: the free-queue window, and the paid "Skip the Line" slots that let a launch be booked for a specific day.

tools.name: get_community_posts
tools.description: The most recent posts from the Awesome Indie community feed.

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Read one community article (markdown body) by its author username and article slug.
